question: Under Regulation (EU) 2021/11391, small-scale coastal fishing benefits from more favourable support conditions but is limited to vessels of less than 12 metres not using towed gear. In many European fleets, however, vessels just above this threshold are family-run, operate with small crews on daily trips and have an economic profile close to that of the small-scale segment. They nonetheless fall outside the definition and are treated in the same way as considerably larger vessels. 1.
Has the Commission assessed whether the 12-metre threshold reflects the reality of family-run fleets?

Will it propose, in the follow-up to the common fisheries policy evaluation or in the fisheries component of the 2028-2034 multiannual financial framework, a definition based on criteria such as trip duration, crew size or ownership structure rather than length alone?
Pending such a change, will it allow Member States to extend small-scale support measures to vessels of up to 15 metres?
Regulation (EU) 2021/1139 of 7 July 2021 establishing the European Maritime, Fisheries and Aquaculture Fund (ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2021/1139/oj). 1
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (23.11.2026) The definition of the small-scale coastal fishing, set out in the Regulation establishing the European Maritime, Fisheries and Aquaculture Fund1 is used to establish eligibility for certain types of financial support. The new proposal for the 2028-2034 multiannual financial framework2 maintains the same definition for small-scale coastal fishing.
It also envisages that Member States will have to include measures covering activities supporting the needs of coastal communities in the National and Regional Partnership Plans.

The latter will give Member States more flexibility to tailor their budget in accordance with national, regional and local needs and will provide them the possibility to define other fleet segments to be prioritised, in addition to small-scale coastal fishing, based on other criteria such as the ownership (family-run vessels), the technology used or the contribution to local markets.
1 Regulation (EU) 2021/1139 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 7 July 2021 establishing the

European Maritime, Fisheries and Aquaculture Fund and amending Regulation (EU) 2017/1004 (OJ L 247, 13.7.2021, p. 1, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2021/1139/oj), Article 2, paragraph 2, subparagraph 14.

2 Article 4(26) of the Proposal for a REGULATION OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL establishing the European Fund for economic, social and territorial cohesion, agriculture and rural, fisheries and maritime, prosperity and security for the period 2028-2034 and amending Regulation (EU) 2023/955 and Regulation (EU, Euratom) 2024/2509: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legalcontent/EN/TXT/?uri=celex:52025PC0565.
